name: Jiminny
description: Ask Claude anything about your calls, deals and customers. Jiminny brings the context: transcripts, insights and deal data, so every answer is grounded in reality.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Jiminny to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Jiminny to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.jiminny.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Jiminny MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jiminny provides these MCP tools: get_call, get_deal, get_deal_activities, get_me, list_call_options, list_deal_options, search_calls, search_deals, search_members, list_regions, and change_region.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Jiminny?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Jiminny in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Jiminny requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Jiminny is developed by Jiminny. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
